text_block_list.name: Ai's Fan
text_block_list.text: "Skipping both the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe and the Victoria Mile is honestly such a huge bummer! I wanna see Ai-chan run soon!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan
text_block_list.text:
With Almond Eye absent,
will Lucky Lilac take the spotlight after all...?
If that happens, it's gonna be so hype...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...So in the end, Ai-san
didn't run in the Victoria Mile after all, huh.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was wonderin' what I'd do if it came out,
so to be honest, I'm pretty grateful.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No. That's not it.
...I'm still on the road to making my comeback.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm really gonna compete with Ai-san,
it'll be after I reclaim my throne as 'Queen.'"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And I wanna win head-on
so I can say that I'm the star.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: For that reason, I must secure a solid victory today.

...It seems my worries were unfounded.
She has already set her mind toward what needs to be done.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Heh... heheh...!
Ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, sorry about that.
It just felt like it'd been so long
since I heard you play the fool, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Guess she didn't even have the leeway for that.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
Thanks to you, I have warmed up nicely.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
At today's Victoria Mile, too,
I'll deliver a victory that'll leave everyone thoroughly floored.
choice_data_list: Um, aren't you going to play the straight man to that joke...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Seriously, how badly do you wanna be called out?!

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Voice
text_block_list.text:
"And now, the competing Umamusume have gathered in the paddock.
The top favorite this time is—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...I can feel it, even through the screen.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: You've gotten even stronger since the Osaka Hai, Lala!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Show me.
Show me how you run now...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...Come to think of it, my big breakthroughs always tend to happen in Kansai, like the Hanshin JF and Osaka Hai.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(In the midst of all that,
today is a GⅠ at Tokyo Racecourse...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(At Tokyo Racecourse, where Ai-san changed history,
I'll aim for my revival as the "Queen"—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Fine by me!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(It feels like an away game today.
But winning anyway is what makes a true "Queen"!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
âLucky Lilac.
I shall bloom in the mile as well.
